policy_version: General Terms, intrusion-testing agreement, and CSIRT reference as retrieved 2026-08-03; exact document versions in the private review record
notes: The published intrusion-testing agreement authorizes technical tests only on infrastructure dedicated to the client, prohibits shared-resource/API/DoS/load tests, requires dates approved by the provider's security team, and requires notification at least one month before testing with scope, source IPs, tools, contacts, and dates. A separate CSIRT document provides an incident-reporting channel but is not prior authorization. Classified needs-written-permission; attach the approved testing reference before any probe. Authorization request sent 2026-08-03; awaiting response. Real provider identity, source URLs, and the contact address are kept in the untracked private review record (CHARTER.md §7.6).
